name: SeedMsg
meaning: messages handled and sent by Seed_HandleMessage 0x4ea560

name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: 4 CTX_PICKUP for the Wolf or a Robot (no state check)

name: MSG_PICKUP
meaning: attach to sender joint arg, state 2

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: detach to arg pos; drop flag bit 0 gives state 3 (plant)

name: MSG_INVENTORY_STORED
meaning: state 1 and flags |= 8 (SCN_OF_KEPT): the seed is committed the moment it enters the inventory

name: MSG_QUERY_HELD_ACTION
meaning: 0x18 HELD_SEED_PLANT when the sender's pos is inside a BOXES box (3-axis)

name: MSG_TIMEMACHINE_SWAP_OUT
meaning: relocate g_pSheepOutOfZone / Gossamer out of the present tree boxes, then Tree msg 0x3300

name: MSG_SEED_QUERY_TREE_POS
meaning: from Tree: planted seed returns the XZ centre of its box at the seed's height

name: MSG_SEED_QUERY_ARRIVAL
meaning: from TimeMachineSphere state 8: box corner for the Wolf (max) or Gossamer (min), y = seed - 20
